parsed.observations: Close-up of wheat leaf tissue with numerous brick-red to red-brown pustules, many elongated, with pale, torn-looking epidermal margins. Pustules are irregularly scattered rather than forming consistent stripes. No clear powdery growth or black-dotted necrotic blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible elongated brick-red pustules with torn-looking epidermal margins support stem rust on the leaf tissue.
